identity.name: G-Shock Full Metal 2100 Series
identity.one_liner: The 2022 full-metal G-Shock that became a horological moment — the same octagonal case as the 2100 Casioak, in a 40mm stainless steel body with Tough Solar and Bluetooth.

provenance_events.description: Casio releases the GM-B2100 in stainless steel with the same octagonal 2100 case as the 2019 Casioak GA-2100 — full metal, Tough Solar, Bluetooth, 200m water resistance.

narrative.story: The 2019 GA-2100 Casioak was Casio's most-cited 21st-century G-Shock. The 2022 GM-B2100 brought the same case in full stainless steel with Tough Solar radio-controlled accuracy and Bluetooth, at $500. The result: a $500 watch that wears like a Royal Oak and ticks like a Casio.
narrative.collector_notes: The full-metal case weighs 167g — about 3x the resin 2100. The dial is a black sunray with applied indices.
